title: Offer an opt-in deterministic updated-at ordering across all six canonical Command Work Queue views
goal: Deliver CAP-CMD-101 Class-0 manual newest/oldest ordering on the existing host-authorized Command Work Queue projection and native HTML browser, without a second sorting engine or Saved View persistence.
invariants: Keep six immutable Command system views and exactly one GET /command/work-queue route; optional sort=newest|oldest uses existing owner-provided UpdatedAt timestamp, never another route/field or Shared Saved View.
Default without sort remains newest-first and JSON response unchanged. Equal-time deterministic Kind/ID tie-break and 5000 candidate/50 visible row bound remain.
Project evaluates fresh server-side tenant/environment/Incident/Task CanRead before sorting; sort may not alter which entity is authorized or permission scopes.
HTML same-route GET form permits manual newest/oldest selection; six view links retain both current status and sort, escaped with html/template and url.QueryEscape.
No new durable state, mutation, source provider, search engine, arbitrary column schema, or priority comparator (final sort columns still canonical OPEN UX question).
security_properties: Reject unknown, repeated or malformed sort query keys before session/owner resolution; client cannot choose principal/tenant/environment or arbitrary owner column.
Authorized rows only, sort and status applied after per-object CanRead; no cross-tenant ACL probes; owner failure/revocation returns no partial response.
Retain no-store/nosniff/CSP default-src none; HTML GET form-action self, safe template escaping and URL encoding; no scripts.
Single Owner.List and no extra owner CanRead passes; no new permissions to create/update or save a view.

migration.rationale: Read-only optional query choice on existing stable first-party Command route; no stored schema change

rollback.strategy: Remove SortOrder field, query option, HTML sort control and tests; prior newest-first status-filter projection unchanged
verification: Original six views and status filter continue working
No Shared Saved View state stored or modified

inputs: Canonical CAP-CMD-101 §§1–27 requirement to manually sort the Unified Work Queue, and canonical six-view catalogue
Current already-authorized Command Work Queue Project (UpdatedAt RFC3339Nano, deterministic newest-first order)
E10-CMD-101D-STATUS prior exact-head SUCCESS #161 and its owner-authenticated single-route HTML GET filter
outputs: Exact optional sort choice newest/oldest over owner-resolved UpdatedAt, applied after authorization and before 50-row bound
Six-view HTML navigation preserves status and sort and GET form applies it on the same route
Legacy no-sort JSON response unchanged, filtered JSON adds explicit sort only when selected
acceptance_tests: Given 3 independently authorized Command items, verify default/newest/oldest timestamp order and stable Kind/ID tie-break; status/view intersections unchanged.
Owner.CanRead executed on all in-scope records before filtering/sorting; denied-only rows and foreign tenant metadata absent; invalid order rejected before authorization.
Six canonical views same GET route in JSON/HTML; sort/status retained in GET form and escaped links; malformed, repeated, injected or arbitrary sort rejected.
Bounded 5000 candidates / 50 output rows, SLA Partial state and first-page-only diagnostic remain deterministic.

Exact HEAD GitHub Actions command-work-queue-runtime Linux/macOS/Windows and engineering-kernel mandatory checks, no coverage waivers; one independent read-only L2 if material and not already scheduled.

performance_budget.rationale: Reuse exact existing sorting over authorized candidate slice; only comparator direction flag, no extra sort pass/provider call/network/storage
metrics: No additional Owner.CanRead relative to existing Project
Same O(n log n) sorting for <=5000 candidates, 50 displayed rows
